tab.title: Connections
tab.empty: No Connections yet. A Connection tells Wallet Accountant how your bank's statement files are laid out.

editor.description: Describe how your bank's statement files are laid out. Open one of its files as a sample and most of this is filled in for you.
editor.name: Name
editor.futureOnly: Changes apply to future imports. To re-read a file already imported, Void its Statement import and import it again.

sample.title: Sample file
sample.description: Open one of your bank's statement files. It is read here, in your browser, to guess the settings below; only “Read the sample” sends it, and nothing keeps it.
sample.guessed: Settings guessed from {{name}}. Check them, then pick each column.
sample.noDates: No column of {{name}} reads as dates in a format listed here: choose the date format yourself.
sample.tableCaption: The first and last rows of {{name}}, with their line numbers. Pick what each column holds with its button.
sample.empty: The sample has no rows after the lines skipped.

file.title: File
file.headerRow: The first line names the columns
file.skipLeadingLines: Lines to skip at the top
file.skipLeadingLinesHelp: Lines before the column names or the first row, such as an account summary.
file.skipTrailingLines: Lines to skip at the bottom
file.skipTrailingLinesHelp: Lines after the last row, such as totals or a closing balance.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Booking date, description and the amount are needed; the rest only when the file has them.

positive.moneyOut: Money out (the bank inverts the sign)

rules.nameTooLong: A name has at most 100 characters
rules.delimiter: Use one character other than a quote
rules.skipLeadingLines: Type a whole number, 0 or more
rules.skipTrailingLines: Type a whole number, 0 or more
rules.separatorsEqual: Choose a thousands separator other than the decimal separator
rules.amountLayout: Choose how amounts are laid out
rules.positiveAmountMeans: Say whether a positive amount is money in or money out
rules.columnUsedTwice: This column is already used for {{field}}
rules.headerWithoutHeaderRow: This column is named by its header, but the file has no header row: choose it again

test.title: How rows will read
test.description: Your sample read with this mapping by Wallet Accountant, exactly as an import would read it. Nothing is recorded.
test.needsSample: Open a sample file to see how its rows will read.
test.stale: The mapping has changed since. Read the sample again.
test.firstAndLast_one: The first {{first}} and the last row:
test.tableCaption: The first rows as they will read
test.tableCaptionFirstAndLast: The first and last rows as they will read
